message.reasoning:
We need to decide whether to buy Vermont Avenue (light blue) for $100. Player p1 (Alpha) has cash 420. Already owns Oriental Avenue and Connecticut Avenue (both light blue). So they own 2 of 3 in group, need Vermont to have monopoly. Buying gives monopoly, can later build houses. So buying is good. Opponents: Beta has Kentucky and Indiana (red). Gamma has Reading RR and Electric Company. Delta has none. So buying gives monopoly, good.

Consider cash after purchase: 420-100=320. Still decent.

Auction could let others buy cheap? But we want monopoly. So buy.

Public message: maybe say "I buy it." Could also be friendly. Private thought: reasoning.

Make tool call buy_property with messages.
